items.rationale: Surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and stays within the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit. The endorsement in the description waives the 50% reduction for missing surge protection, so this is a full like-for-like replacement under 7.1.9; Case 1 (halved, two devices ~840) implies roughly 1,700 unhalved for both devices together.
Carriage or delivery of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b) and is excluded.
Fitting, installing or commissioning replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).
Surge-damaged TV covered under 2.3.3 within the EUR 5,000 sub-limit. There is no halving because of the waiver endorsement, so this is an equivalent standard-grade replacement under 7.1.9.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: The charge bundles property damage with a liability risk without separate pricing, so it falls outside cover entirely under 3.1.4 and 7.1.8(f).

items.description: Service order under the property/liability arrangement
items.rationale: A charge for placing an order under a service arrangement is excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Under 7.1.8(d), an attendance charge is only payable on an invoice whose own work is indemnifiable; nothing on this invoice is, consistent with Case 1.
